issue.title: installConfig: null causes a nil panic

relevant_locations.role: Service installation entry point that retrieves service configuration
Loads and merges cluster configuration from YAML

llm_context.input_title: installConfig: null causes a nil panic
llm_context.input_body: No body provided in issue description.

generated_output.summary: When a user supplies `installConfig: null` in their k0s configuration file, k0s encounters a nil panic during service installation because the configuration parser or service config builder attempts to access fields on the uninitialized/null `installConfig` structure without a proper nil check.
generated_output.root_cause_analysis: The YAML unmarshaling or subsequent configuration processing maps `installConfig: null` to a nil pointer reference in the cluster configuration spec. When downstream functions attempt to read or configure service installation parameters from `installConfig`, the lack of a protective nil check triggers a runtime panic.

step_by_step_plan.title: Inspect InstallService and NodeConfig
step_by_step_plan.description: Examine pkg/install/service.go and pkg/config/cfgvars.go to identify where installConfig is accessed and where the nil pointer dereference occurs when installConfig is explicitly set to null.

step_by_step_plan.title: Add Nil Check for installConfig
step_by_step_plan.description: Update InstallService and configuration loading logic to safely check if installConfig is nil before accessing its fields, applying default initialization if necessary.

step_by_step_plan.title: Implement Regression Test
step_by_step_plan.description: Add a new test case in pkg/config/runtime_test.go or a service install test that explicitly loads a cluster configuration with 'installConfig: null' and verifies that no nil panic occurs.

step_by_step_plan.title: Run Tests
step_by_step_plan.description: Execute the test suite to verify that the fix correctly handles null installConfig values without regressions.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Attempting to read or write through a pointer variable whose value is nil (points to nothing).
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: In Go, uninitialized pointers or explicit YAML `null` values decode to nil. Accessing fields on them causes an immediate runtime panic, crashing the application.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: The issue is caused directly by `installConfig: null` decoding to a nil pointer and subsequently being accessed without a preceding nil check.

structured_concepts.short_explanation: Validating that a pointer is not nil before accessing its fields or methods.
structured_concepts.why_it_matters: External input like configuration files can contain missing or explicitly null fields. Defensive checks make applications robust against unexpected or sparse user input.
structured_concepts.connection_to_issue: Adding a safe nil check or initializing default values when `installConfig` is nil will prevent the panic and resolve the issue.

common_pitfalls: Forgetting to check nested pointer fields within `installConfig` after adding a top-level nil check.
Modifying unrelated configuration structs or changing default behavior for valid non-nil configurations.
